items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The two Franks were in Basie’s band together along with Thad and Graham... I mentioned earlier, Frank Foster was a member of that band at the Three Sixes in Detroit

ctx.x: Well, you did that Elvin Jones date on the Riverside that same year. You had Frank and Frank.

Right, that was with Elvin. Thad wrote some of the arrangements. I think both Franks wrote on arrangement. Art Davis was the bass player. He was a very sure-footed bass player. He reminded me a lot of George Devivier. He played excellent, solid base notes. He wasn't as well known as a soloist as he was as a good ensemble player. He teaches now at college in California. I think it is San Diego.
Isn’t he a psychologist? Doesn’t he have a PhD in something that’s not music?
